URL: https://www.opinium.com/resource-center/voting-intention-4th-november-2026/
Outlet: Opinium (for the Observer), published 7 November 2026 (fieldwork 4-6 November 2026, 2,050 UK adults 18+)

Voting intention: 4th November 2026

Voting Intention
- Labour: 28% (-2)
- Reform UK: 21% (-1)
- Conservatives: 20% (no change)
- Greens: 11% (+3)
- Liberal Democrats: 10% (no change)

Leader Approval (Net Ratings)
- Andy Burnham: +5 (-2)
- Kemi Badenoch: -1
- Ed Davey: -5
- Nigel Farage: -27
- Zack Polanski: -30

"Labour maintains a seven-point lead over Reform UK in Opinium's latest poll for the Observer, despite both parties seeing their vote shares fall slightly."

Best Prime Minister Preferences
Against Badenoch: Burnham 41% vs Conservative leader 22%
Against Farage: Burnham 47% vs Reform leader 22%
